**How it was verified:** `go test ./...` against the Ralph repo, `guard` on the changed spec, `golangci-lint run` (0 issues), and `go test -cover ./internal/...` (ralph coverage 88.3%). 809 insertions landed across `internal/controller/delta.go`, `delta_test.go`, RunLoop/scheduler/handleSessionComplete wiring, and the prompt template.

**Test cases (`delta_test.go` + integration tests):**

| Case | Setup | Expectation |
|---|---|---|
| First-run cursor | empty store, 5 deltas | `ResolveCursor` returns `[0,0)`; summary has 0 in-window deltas (baseline pass) |
| Resume after commit | cursor at `[3,3)`, commit `abc` | next pass window starts at offset 3; deltas 0–2 excluded from prompt |
| Resume after crash | cursor at `[2,5)` persisted, no commit | window stays `[2,5)`; failed deltas retried, nothing skipped |
| Window clamp | cursor.To beyond len(deltas) | clamped to `len(deltas)`; no OOB |
| Out-of-window exclusion | deltas at offsets 0..4, window `[2,4)` | only offsets 2,3 in `DeltaIDs`/files/statuses |
| Dedup + sort | same file in two deltas | file listed once, files sorted |
| Status aggregation | 2 pending, 1 failed, 1 skipped | `Statuses` map counts correct |
| Scope paths | IOConfig reads `pkg/a`, writes `pkg/b` | `Scope.String()` → `read:pkg/a,write:pkg/b` (sorted) |
| Success advance | commit OK | cursor advances to `[To, To)`, `LastAppliedCommit` set |
| Failed commit | commit failed | cursor unchanged (idempotent retry) |
| Store error | `GetCursor` returns error | `ResolveCursor` wraps and surfaces; loop aborts cleanly |
| Scheduler parity | cursor `[2,7)` | scheduler scans only offsets 2..6, no overlap with committed range |
| Prompt render | built summary | `Render()` contains range, file count, statuses, scope line |

Edge cases covered: zero/empty store, cursor beyond data, half-open range boundaries, duplicate files across deltas, retry-without-commit, and concurrent scheduler/loop sharing one store (advance is a single `UpdateCursor` write → last-writer-wins, no double processing window).
